methodology.sharpe: (3Y CAGR - 6.5% risk-free rate) / annualised standard deviation
methodology.sortino: (3Y CAGR - 6.5% risk-free rate) / annualised downside deviation
methodology.rolling: Monthly observations; annualised CAGR for 1Y/3Y/5Y windows
methodology.nfoConsensus: Official evidence is highest confidence; two independent matching sources are cross-verified; a single credible source with valid dates remains visible as single-source observed; date conflicts remain in Discovery Watch.
methodology.weekendPolicy: Refresh jobs run by calendar schedule. NAV/returns can remain at the last dealing day while NFO, filings, TER, scheme master and operational notices can still change on non-trading days.
methodology.lowLatency: App loads funds-lite.json first; full funds and variants are lazy-loaded only for details/export.
methodology.officialAmcWatch: AMFI member directory discovers official AMC websites; bounded homepage/sitemap scanning detects NFO/addendum/notice/factsheet changes. Official web discoveries supplement, not silently overwrite, central AMFI/SEBI data.
methodology.deepEnrichment: Rotating scheme-detail plus portfolio enrichment: ratios, allocation, top holdings, sectors, credit quality and manager tenure where structured sources supply them; valid older values are retained on source failure.
